## Problem

What problem would this feature solve? Who would benefit from it?

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior or user experience you would like.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds.

## Scope and compatibility

- Does this affect provider data or normalization?
- Does this change browser-side privacy behavior?
- Does this require a new dependency or external service?

## Additional context

Screenshots, examples, source links, or related issues are welcome. Please do not include credentials or private provider data.
